review:
Little Shark under the waves, with two bonuses: Sharks & Ladders, based on the board game, and a Coin Respin hold-and-win.

Pink pearls carry additive multipliers (+1x up to +20x) and orange pearls multiply (2x, 3x, 5x, 10x). In the base game, eight or more '+' multipliers in one spin pay like regular symbols. Little Shark reacts to everything as it happens. Medium-high volatility, 5,000x max and 97% RTP.
pros: Excellent 97.00% RTP – among the highest published
Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
